## Steering committee {#committee}

The project steering committee brings together project collaborators and national-level institutional stakeholders. 
It meets annually to monitor progress, discuss advances, and ensure alignment between research outputs and policy or operational priorities.

* Caroline Bedeau - [**ONF-Guyane RDI**](https://www.onf.fr/onf/%2B/73::onf-en-guyane.html)

* Isabelle Bonjour - [**Centre Technique des Bois et Forêts de Guyane**](https://ctbf-guyane.fr/)

* Nicolas Perthuisot - [**ONF international**](https://www.onfinternational.org/en)

* Driss Ezzine-de-Blas - Socioeconomist [**CIRAD**](https://ur-forets-societes.cirad.fr/)

* *TBD* - [**Programa de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento da Silvicultura de Espécies Nativas**](https://coalizaobr.com.br/nativas/)
